prompt:
Create a production inventory sprite atlas for the Greek fantasy RPG in the reference style: rich painterly gold, silver and leather, detailed readable game equipment. Exactly SIX distinct equipment icons on a 1536 by 1024 canvas, THREE columns by TWO rows, each cell 512 square. Each item is a different original authored silhouette, not six recolors. Each complete item fits inside a 410 by 420 pixel central area of its cell with plenty of empty transparent padding, no clipped corners or ornaments. TRUE ALPHA transparent background, fully transparent empty cells, openings and holes. No backdrop, ground, glow cloud, cast shadow plate, text, numbers, labels, card frame or UI. No person, skin, hands, mannequin or body inside. Separate cleanly cut out equipment only.
Each cell shows one EMPTY lightweight assassin hood with a small forehead clasp, leather brow guard and neatly folded fabric sides. Hood opening fully transparent. Compact agile stealth hood, never full plate helmet, no face, head or eyes. Different crest, fold and hood edge shapes for each tier.
Cell order left to right top then bottom: T7 Styx charcoal leather, black silver edges and teal river gem; T8 oracle ivory leather, gold sun motifs and sapphire; T9 Titan brown leather, geometric bronze details and dark obsidian; T10 cloudgate blue grey leather, silver cloud curves and ice gem; T11 Elysium pale leather, white gold laurel and green gem; T12 cosmos navy star leather with gold constellations and sapphire.
